certify_rank.proof_argument: M=UV bounds rank(M)<=r; LU=I gives rank(U)>=r, and VR=I gives rank(V)>=r. Together rank(UV)=r. Rational Gram matrices U^T U are invertible for independent columns because sums of rational squares vanish only when each term is zero.

Input and transpose copies are made once where ownership requires them; coordinates and inverse outputs move coefficients out of working storage. Pivot divisors and elimination factors move out of the row rather than cloning operands in its arithmetic loop. Conservative phase field-operation counts are charged without refunds; scalar bit sizes, validation, hashing, comparison, allocator internals and elapsed time are outside this count.

Positive-rank identity replay checks the sum of all three product work bounds before allocating I_r; individual products debit that same sum. verify_against checks input cells and binding before replay, without cloning the candidate.
RankLimits/RankBudget.zero: Canonical zero matrices require no field work; rank-zero maps have zero-area buffers, including usize::MAX by zero metadata. Nonzero storage remains subject to the cell limit.
RankLimits/RankBudget.limits: Counts are phase bounds, not an exact event counter, byte limit, BigInt bound, deadline or aggregate memory bound.

Normalization moves the pivot to an owned divisor and writes one; clear_row uses disjoint slices, moves its factor and writes zero. Remaining entries use borrowed exact Q arithmetic. All private ranges follow admitted shape and row bounds.
RationalRows/rational_rref/rational_inve.factorization: Pivot columns of the original M form U. The first rank rows of reduced M form V; truncating and moving the row buffer preserves M=UV. A full-column-rank Q matrix has positive-definite Gram matrix, giving L=(U^T U)^-1 U^T and the analogous section of V. Public identity replay is required before evidence construction.
